[[The Mindclouder]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Eshim Mindclouder]], a [[boss]] in [[Sunward Marches]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Illusion Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%) 
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as a [[Jeweled Staff]] [[dye]]d black.

**[[Tormented Staff]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]

*[[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following [[Illusion Magic]] [[staves]]:

**[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Mesmeric Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Staff]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]]

==Unique counterparts==
*The [[Illusion Magic]] version of the [[Staff of the Forgotten (unique)]] has stats identical to this item.
*[[Traveler's Bo Staff]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Fire damage]] and requires [[Divine Favor]], [[Soul Reaping]], [[Fast Casting]], [[Energy Storage]], or [[Spawning Power]].
*[[Staff of Despair]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it requires [[Domination Magic]].
